title: Short send-message — body gets quoted, name outside
raw: text john hey we're running five minutes late
reference: Text John: “Hey, we're running five minutes late.”
notes: Message body detection on short input. 'John' capitalized. Body goes in curly quotes. 'five minutes' must NOT become '5 minutes' — it's casual prose where small numbers stay spelled out. 'we're' keeps apostrophe. The colon after 'John' is required.
